scale.unresolved: The request depends on missing requirements, so domain involvement cannot be established.
scale.absent: No requested deliverable falls within the defined domain. Excluded and incidental activities do not count.
scale.supporting: A requested deliverable requires a subordinate contribution within the defined domain.
scale.central: A main requested deliverable falls within the defined domain.

domains.description: Author or modify executable software, scripts, APIs, integrations, or configuration. Running existing build, signing, installation, or deployment commands without changing software belongs to operations.
domains.name: Software implementation

domains.description: Diagnose the cause of an observed software or system defect or incident and verify a repair. Reviewing code for possible defects belongs to verification; ordinary creative revisions are outside this domain.
domains.name: Debugging

domains.description: Design or run software/system tests, audit behavior, review code, or check an implementation against a specification. Ordinary source fact checking belongs to research.
domains.name: Testing and code review

domains.description: Design component boundaries, data flows, interfaces, infrastructure, or a technical migration.
domains.name: Architecture and systems design

domains.description: Deploy, release, install, configure, monitor, maintain, or operate software systems or local machines, including storage and cache cleanup. Authoring software belongs to implementation.
domains.name: Deployment and operations

domains.description: Assess or implement security, privacy, authentication, authorization, or abuse controls.
domains.name: Security and privacy

domains.description: Deliver a sourced synthesis, comparison, or factual investigation of external or repository information, including current purchasing options. Routine code reading during implementation or review is outside this domain.
domains.name: Research

domains.description: Calculate, analyze data, model uncertainty, or draw statistical conclusions. Applying a simple numeric filter to search results is outside this domain.
domains.name: Data analysis and statistics

domains.description: Reason through explicit scientific, mathematical, or engineering concepts beyond routine arithmetic. Visual depiction of physical objects alone is outside this domain.
domains.name: Scientific and mathematical reasoning

domains.description: Define a product's goals, requirements, priorities, features, tradeoffs, or acceptance criteria. Selecting existing items to buy is outside this domain.
domains.name: Product planning

domains.description: Choose existing goods or services to buy under constraints such as price, quantity, availability, ratings, or delivery. Designing a new product is outside this domain.
domains.name: Purchasing decisions

domains.description: Design game mechanics, level structure, progression, balance, or systems for player learning and engagement. Authoring prose, lessons, dialogue, or visual assets within an already specified game design belongs to the corresponding content domain; a game setting alone does not establish game design work.
domains.name: Game design

domains.description: Design the visible layout, typography, colors, iconography, or visual hierarchy of an interface.
domains.name: UI visual design

domains.description: Design user journeys, controls, information architecture, accessibility, or interaction behavior.
domains.name: UX and interaction design

domains.description: Create or direct illustration, concept art, graphic assets, textures, or game visual style.
domains.name: Art and visual assets

domains.description: Create or reason about 3D models, geometry, rigging, spatial composition, or physical form. A 2D reference counts when its views specify 3D form or proportions; visual style alone belongs to visual art.
domains.name: 3D and spatial work

domains.description: Create or direct motion, poses changing over time, keyframes, timing, or transitions. Static multi-angle reference sheets are outside this domain.
domains.name: Animation and motion

domains.description: Create, edit, select, or evaluate sound, music, speech, or audio behavior.
domains.name: Audio and music

domains.description: Create or edit a requested prose, copy, narrative, or communication deliverable. Merely writing a response or code-review findings does not add this domain. Technical instructions and specifications belong to documentation.
domains.name: Writing and editing

domains.description: Deliver translated or culturally adapted text while preserving meaning and voice. Clarifying the meaning of an incidental foreign word is outside this domain.
domains.name: Translation and localization

domains.description: Write instructions, specifications, or explanatory reference material for a system or process. Visual reference images alone are outside this domain.
domains.name: Technical documentation
